briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF M-000
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- warehouse roof: (57, 102), roof
- solar canopy: (-6, 143), roof
- control room: (49, -128), indoor
- workshop: (-39, 71), indoor
- parking lot: (82, -70), outdoor
- east fence: (-41, -32), outdoor
- gate 2: (-35, 120), outdoor

Robots:
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1500 s, including the return to its start.
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 9 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2940 s, including the return to its start.
- M2 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 8 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2580 s, including the return to its start.
- M3 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 6 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2940 s, including the return to its start.
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1380 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Tighten the valve at east fence. Location: east fence. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T2: Replace the filter cartridge at control room. Location: control room. Duration: 180 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T3: Replace the filter cartridge at control room. Location: control room. Duration: 270 s. Needs: robotic arm. Can start only after T5 is finished.
- T4: Inspect solar canopy with a camera. Location: solar canopy. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera. Deadline: finished by t = 300 s.
- T5: Deliver the battery pack (9 kg) to control room. Location: control room. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 9 kg).
- T6: Collect a soil sample (2 kg) at parking lot and keep it on board. Location: parking lot. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 2 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 660 s.
- T7: Replace the filter cartridge at workshop. Location: workshop. Duration: 240 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T8: Inspect warehouse roof with a camera. Location: warehouse roof. Duration: 60 s. Needs: camera. Deadline: finished by t = 180 s.
- T9: Photograph gate 2 for the condition report. Location: gate 2. Duration: 90 s. Needs: camera. Deadline: finished by t = 300 s.
- T10: Inspect solar canopy with a camera. Location: solar canopy. Duration: 150 s. Needs: camera.

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Keep at least 1 quadcopter on standby: it must not be given any task.
6. Every task must be finished by t = 1200 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Here's what we need from the robots today.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: warehouse roof (57, 102, a rooftop); solar canopy (-6, 143, a rooftop); control room (49, -128, indoors); workshop (-39, 71, indoors); parking lot (82, -70, outside); east fence (-41, -32, outside); gate 2 (-35, 120, outside).

The fleet: D1, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera, cruises at 8.5 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 25 minutes of flight time, return trip included. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 9 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 49 minutes including getting back. M2 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 8 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 43 minutes including getting back. M3 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 6 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 49 minutes including getting back. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 7 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 23 minutes including the flight home.

Jobs:
(T1) The valve at east fence needs tightening - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T2) Change the filter at control room - that takes 3 minutes on site.
(T3) Change the filter at control room - that takes 4.5 minutes on site but only once the battery pack (T5) has arrived.
(T4) Get eyes on solar canopy and check the panels - that takes 2 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 5 minutes.
(T5) Control room needs the battery pack, which weighs 9 kg - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T6) Pick up a soil sample at parking lot and keep it on board; it weighs 2 kg - that takes 2.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 11 minutes.
(T7) Change the filter at workshop - that takes 4 minutes on site.
(T8) Have a look at warehouse roof - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 3 minutes.
(T9) We need pictures of gate 2 for the report - that takes 1.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 5 minutes.
(T10) Get eyes on solar canopy and check the panels - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.

Keep one quadcopter on standby; don't give it any jobs. Everything has to be wrapped up within 20 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
